column1: # Third-party apt repositories used by "apt-repo:<repo>:<package>" methods in baseline.tsv.
#   repo          key used by the install methods
#   key_url       the signing key published by the vendor (armored or binary)
#   fingerprints  comma-separated primary-key fingerprints the downloaded key must consist of; a key with any
#                 other primary key is refused before it is trusted
#   uri suite components   the apt source; the architecture is always amd64 (DESIGN.md section 1)
# {distro} and {codename} in a URL or the suite stand for this device's os-release ID and release code name
# File names and source lines follow each vendor's own instructions, so a repository set up by hand is recognized.
# Docker's key is the one its install guides have always used ("Docker Release (CE deb)"); the fingerprint was
# printed in docs.docker.com's Ubuntu and Debian guides (docker/docs, engine/install/{ubuntu,debian}.md).
